scenario: LCYC.3.1.1: a two-rule SCC whose every internal edge is a `withdraw` edge (LCYC.3.2.2) is admitted. `ra` withdraws a `B` that `rb` matches, and `rb` withdraws an `A` that `ra` matches, so the two rules reach each other and form one SCC. No schema is emitted at all, so none is both emitted and matched inside it, and no rule carries `call`, `cache` or `cache_delete`. Compiles. PATH PINNED: `dsc.cycle`'s withdraw edges make the SCC, and `lcyc_3_1_1_admitted` lets it through. Without the admission, the cycle check would refuse it with DS_VALIDATE_RULE_CYCLE. Twin: LCYC.3.1.1_emit_and_withdraw_scc_refused.
rules_ds:
schema A scope explicit:
    v: Int

schema B scope explicit:
    v: Int

rule ra:
    A a
    B b where b.v == a.v
->
    withdraw b

rule rb:
    B b
    A a where a.v == b.v
->
    withdraw a
